title: Jorabat Mountain Pass Freight Bottleneck
explanation: Landslide debris on NH-6/NH-27 pass. Outbound freight to Meghalaya & Tripura delayed by 3.8 hours.
recommended_action: Divert via Garchuk staging yard or wait at Jorabat depot.

title: GS Road & Zoo Road Waterlogging Corridor

recommended_action: Reroute heavy trucks through VIP road or express bypass.

title: Kamakhya Foothills Soil Slumping Corridor

title: Sonapur-Jagiroad Freight Bypass Potholes
